reason: A web review plugin for previewing frontend pages, annotating selected elements, testing temporary visual adjustments, and supplying structured feedback to an agent for source changes.

summaries.zh: 用于在内置浏览器中预览网页、批注页面元素并进行临时视觉调整，再将结构化反馈提供给智能体修改前端源码。
summaries.en: A plugin for previewing webpages, annotating elements, testing temporary visual adjustments, and sending structured feedback to an agent for frontend source changes.

capabilities: opens web pages in an embedded browser
provides temporary visual style adjustments for preview
sends annotation context to an agent for frontend source modifications
supports UI-focused skills for typography, layout, accessibility, colors, and interface review
